messages:
laura: bumping this — PR #4123 is ready for review. It's the migration guide for the new routing policy. Need merge before cutoff on Tue EOD.

sam: taking a look now, will do a quick pass for wording. Who's the formal docs reviewer? @ana?

ana: I can review. Quick Q: should examples use `redwood.dedicated` or `redwood.private`? Keep generic?

laura: make examples use the hosted API plus a note about Dedicated. Use `redwood.api.request({model: 'rw-large'})` in snippet.

sam: CI docs preview failed with linkcheck: `/docs/migrate/old-routing` -> 404. docs-bot attached logs.

docs-bot: linkcheck error in PR #4123 — broken link at /docs/migrate/old-routing. Full log: https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/4123/linkcheck

ben: I can fix that path, I moved the page last week. Suggested patch: update to `/docs/migrate/routing-v2`.

ana: LGTM on content after ben's fix. One more: add note about feature flag `routing_v2_default` and the release date.

laura: release/eng plan is to flip flag on 2026-04-01 at 08:00PT. We need docs merged and published by 2026-03-30 EOD.

miriam: is there a versioned docs requirement? This is a breaking change for older pinned customers.

laura: yes, add frontmatter `version: 2026-04` and include migration note in v1.12 -> v1.13 upgrade section.

sam: after ben's path fix I re-ran local build, preview ok. Will push the amended commit in 15m and request merge.

ben: pushed fix and added `version` frontmatter. CI run kicked off: `ci/docs-preview` OK -> green.

docs-bot: docs-preview succeeded for PR #4123. Preview link: https://deploy-preview-4123--redwood-docs.netlify.app

ana: approving now. @laura, any preference for merge timing? We should avoid the monday release window.

laura: merge Monday is ok if we gate by feature flag. But to be safe, merge on Tue 2026-03-31 morning to allow CDN warmup.

sam: scheduled merge for 1768728000 (Tue morning). I'll merge then and watch deploy. :eyes: 

miriam: Can you add a short rollback note in the PR description in case of post-merge problem? e.g., how to flip flag back.

laura: done — PR description updated with rollback steps and who to ping (oncall-eng). Ready to merge when sam triggers.

sam: merged at 1768728000, deploy started. Monitor channel: #release-war-room and I'll post preview.

docs-bot: deploy success. Live URL: https://redwood.ai/docs/migrate/routing-v2 — CDN 95% warm within 30m.

laura: thanks team! closing the loop: update release notes and notify support about versioned change.

ben: I'll send a short blurb to #support now. :rocket:
